Private Function Read1(wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant, o As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.Sheets.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.Worksheets.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.Charts.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = wb.ActiveSheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = TypeName(wb.ActiveSheet)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = TypeName(ActiveChart)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    v = "E": Err.Clear
    v = ws.ChartObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & " "
    Err.Clear
    For Each o In wb.Sheets
        s = s & "[" & o.Name & ":" & TypeName(o) & ":" & o.Index & "]"
    Next
    Err.Clear
    Read1 = s
End Function

Private Sub Act0(ByVal which As Long, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, ch As Object, r As Variant)
    Dim t As Object, u As Object, c2 As Object, p As Object, c3 As Object, c4 As Object, w2 As Object, w3 As Object
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = 0
    Case 1
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = TypeName(t) & " " & t.Name
    Case 2
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet): r = t.Name
    Case 3
        Set t = ch.Location(1): r = t.Name
    Case 4
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, ""): r = t.Name
    Case 5
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "One"): r = t.Name
    Case 6
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "one"): r = t.Name
    Case 7
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "a/b"): r = t.Name
    Case 8
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"): r = t.Name
    Case 9
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"): r = t.Name
    Case 10
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, 12): r = t.Name
    Case 11
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAutomatic): r = TypeName(t) & " " & t.Name
    Case 12
        Set t = ch.Location(3, "Mine"): r = t.Name
    Case 13
        Set t = ch.Location(0): r = 1
    Case 14
        Set t = ch.Location(4): r = 1
    Case 15
        Set t = ch.Location("x"): r = 1
    Case 16
        ch.Location xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine": r = ws.Parent.Sheets.Count
    Case 17
        ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Activate: Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ws.Parent.Sheets(1).Name & " " & ws.Parent.Sheets(2).Name
    Case 18
        ws.Parent.Worksheets("Three").Activate: Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.Index
    Case 19
        ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Visible = False: Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.Index
    Case 20
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.Index & " " & t.Type & " " & t.Visible
    Case 21
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = TypeName(t.Parent) & " " & t.Parent.Name
    Case 22
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ws.Parent.Charts.Count & " " & ws.Parent.Charts(1).Name & " " & ws.Parent.Sheets("Mine").Name & " " & TypeName(ws.Parent.Sheets("Mine"))
    Case 23
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ws.Parent.ActiveSheet.Name & " " & ActiveSheet.Name & " " & TypeName(ActiveSheet) & " " & TypeName(ActiveChart)
    Case 24
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ws.ChartObjects.Count & " " & ws.Shapes.Count
    Case 25
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ws.Parent.Worksheets.Count
    Case 26
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.HasTitle & " " & t.ChartType & " " & t.SeriesCollection.Count & " " & t.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 27
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = TypeName(t.ChartArea) & " " & t.HasLegend
    Case 28
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ch.Name
    Case 29
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = TypeName(ch)
    Case 30
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ch.ChartType
    Case 31
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = co.Name
    Case 32
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = TypeName(co)
    Case 33
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 34
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): Set t = ch.Location(1): Set u = c2.Location(1): r = t.Name & " " & u.Name & " " & u.Index & " " & t.Index
    Case 35
        Set t = ch.Location(1): r = ws.Parent.Charts.Count & " " & t.Name
    Case 36
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): Set t = ch.Location(1, "Chart2"): Set u = c2.Location(1): r = u.Name
    Case 37
        ws.Parent.Worksheets.Add.Name = "Chart1": Set t = ch.Location(1): r = t.Name
    Case 38
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): ch.Location 1, "Mine": Set u = c2.Location(1, "Mine"): r = u.Name
    Case 39
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): t.Name = "Other": r = t.Name
    Case 40
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): t.Move After:=ws.Parent.Sheets(ws.Parent.Sheets.Count): r = t.Index
    Case 41
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): Application.DisplayAlerts = False: t.Delete: r = ws.Parent.Sheets.Count & " " & ws.Parent.Charts.Count & " " & ActiveSheet.Name
    Case 42
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): t.HasTitle = True: t.ChartTitle.Text = "Over": r = t.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 43
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): t.ChartType = xlLine: r = t.ChartType
    Case 44
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): ws.Activate: r = ActiveSheet.Name
    Case 45
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Activate: t.Activate: r = TypeName(ActiveSheet) & " " & ActiveSheet.Name
    Case 46
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): ws.Range("B2").Value = 99: r = t.SeriesCollection(1).Values(1)
    Case 47
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): ws.Rows(1).Insert: r = t.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 48
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): ws.Name = "Renamed": r = t.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 49
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 50
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = TypeName(t.Shapes)
    Case 51
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = ws.Parent.Sheets.Count: ws.Copy After:=ws: r = r & " " & ws.Parent.Sheets.Count
    Case 52
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): Set u = ws.Parent.Worksheets.Add: r = u.Index & " " & u.Name
    Case 53
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): Set u = ws.Parent.Sheets.Add(After:=t): r = u.Index
    Case 54
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = TypeName(t) & " " & t.Name
    Case 55
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.Parent.Name & " " & t.Parent.Parent.Name
    Case 56
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = ws.ChartObjects.Count & " " & ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects.Count
    Case 57
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects(1).Name
    Case 58
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.Parent.Left & " " & t.Parent.Top & " " & t.Parent.Width & " " & t.Parent.Height
    Case 59
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = ActiveSheet.Name & " " & TypeName(ActiveChart)
    End Select
End Sub

Private Sub Act1(ByVal which As Long, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, ch As Object, r As Variant)
    Dim t As Object, u As Object, c2 As Object, p As Object, c3 As Object, c4 As Object, w2 As Object, w3 As Object
    Select Case which
    Case 60
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = ch.ChartType
    Case 61
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = co.Name
    Case 62
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 63
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "One"): r = t.Parent.Name & " " & ws.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 64
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "two"): r = t.Parent.Parent.Name
    Case 65
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Nope"): r = 1
    Case 66
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject): r = 1
    Case 67
        ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects.Add(10, 10, 100, 100).Name = "Taken": Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.Parent.Name & " " & ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects.Count
    Case 68
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): Set u = t.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = TypeName(u) & " " & u.Parent.Name & " " & ws.Parent.Sheets.Count & " " & ws.Parent.Charts.Count
    Case 69
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): Set u = t.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "One"): r = u.Parent.Left & " " & u.Parent.Top & " " & u.Parent.Width
    Case 70
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): Set u = t.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Next"): r = u.Name & " " & ws.Parent.Sheets.Count & " " & ws.Parent.Charts.Count
    Case 71
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): Set u = t.Location(xlLocationAutomatic): r = u.Name
    Case 72
        ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartTitle.Text = "T": Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 73
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 74
        ch.ChartArea.Font.Size = 14: Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.ChartArea.Font.Size
    Case 75
        co.Name = "Named": Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.Name
    Case 76
        Set p = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart: p.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = p.Location(xlLocationAsNewSheet, "Mine"): r = t.ChartStyle
    Case 77
        Set p = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart: p.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = p.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.ChartStyle
    Case 78
        ws.Protect: Set t = ch.Location(1): r = 1
    Case 79
        ws.Parent.Protect Structure:=True: Set t = ch.Location(1): r = 1
    Case 80
        ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Protect: Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = 1
    Case 81
        Set w2 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two"): Set c3 = w2.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c3.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = c3.Location(1, "Mine"): r = t.Index
    Case 82
        Set w3 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Three"): Set c4 = w3.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c4.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = c4.Location(1, "Mine"): r = t.Index
    Case 83
        Set w3 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Three"): Set c4 = w3.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c4.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Activate: Set t = c4.Location(1, "Mine"): r = t.Index
    Case 84
        Set w2 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two"): Set c3 = w2.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c3.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set w3 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Three"): Set c4 = w3.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c4.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = c4.Location(1, "A"): Set u = c3.Location(1, "B"): r = t.Index & " " & u.Index
    Case 85
        Set w2 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two"): Set c3 = w2.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c3.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set w3 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Three"): Set c4 = w3.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c4.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = c3.Location(1, "A"): Set u = c4.Location(1, "B"): r = t.Index & " " & u.Index
    Case 86
        Set w2 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two"): Set c3 = w2.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c3.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = ch.Location(1, "A"): Set u = c3.Location(1, "B"): r = t.Index & " " & u.Index
    Case 87
        Set w2 = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two"): Set c3 = w2.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart: c3.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3"): Set t = c3.Location(1, "A"): Set u = ch.Location(1, "B"): r = t.Index & " " & u.Index
    Case 88
        Set t = ch.Location(1, "A"): r = ws.Previous.Name & " " & t.Next.Name
    Case 89
        ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects.Add(10, 10, 100, 100).Name = "Chart 1": Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.Parent.Name & " " & ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects(1).Name & " " & ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects(2).Name
    Case 90
        ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 10, 10).Name = "Box": Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Shapes(1).Name & " " & ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").Shapes(2).Name
    Case 91
        co.Name = "Named": Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.Parent.Name
    Case 92
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): Set u = t.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "One"): r = u.Parent.Parent.Name & " " & ws.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 93
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): t.Parent.Left = 96: r = t.Parent.Left
    Case 94
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = ws.Parent.Worksheets("Two").ChartObjects(1).Chart.ChartType
    Case 95
        Set t = ch.Location(xlLocationAsObject, "Two"): r = t.Parent.TopLeftCell.Address & " " & t.Parent.BottomRightCell.Address
    Case 96
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): Set t = c2.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 97
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): Set t = c2.Location(2, "Two"): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 98
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): Set t = c2.Location(2, "One"): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 99
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = False: Set t = c2.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 100
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.HasTitle = False: Set t = c2.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 101
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.ChartTitle.Delete: Set t = c2.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 102
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = False: Set t = c2.Location(2, "Two"): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 103
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("B2:B3"): Set t = c2.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 104
        Set t = ch.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 105
        ch.SeriesCollection(2).Delete: Set t = ch.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 106
        ch.ChartType = xlPie: Set t = ch.Location(1): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 107
        ch.ChartType = xlPie: Set t = ch.Location(2, "Two"): r = t.HasTitle
    Case 108
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 109
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.Parent.Activate: r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 110
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.Parent.Select: r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 111
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.ChartArea.Select: r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 112
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): On Error Resume Next: c2.Location 2: r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle
    Case 113
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): On Error Resume Next: c2.Location 2, "Nope": r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle
    Case 114
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): On Error Resume Next: c2.Location 1, "One": r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle
    Case 115
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): On Error Resume Next: c2.Location 9: r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle
    Case 116
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.HasTitle = False: r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 117
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.ChartTitle.Text = "T": c2.HasTitle = False: r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 118
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.HasTitle = False: c2.HasTitle = True: r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 119
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.HasTitle = False: c2.Parent.Activate: r = c2.HasTitle
    End Select
End Sub

Private Sub Act2(ByVal which As Long, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, ch As Object, r As Variant)
    Dim t As Object, u As Object, c2 As Object, p As Object, c3 As Object, c4 As Object, w2 As Object, w3 As Object
    Select Case which
    Case 120
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = False: c2.Parent.Activate: r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 121
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.HasTitle = False: On Error Resume Next: r = TypeName(c2.ChartTitle): r = r & " " & Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0
    Case 122
        ch.HasTitle = True: ch.HasTitle = False: r = ch.HasTitle
    Case 123
        ch.Parent.Activate: r = ch.HasTitle
    Case 124
        ch.SeriesCollection(2).Delete: ch.Parent.Activate: r = ch.HasTitle
    Case 125
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.HasTitle = False: c2.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "New": r = c2.HasTitle
    Case 126
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): c2.HasTitle = True: c2.HasTitle = False: ws.Copy After:=ws: r = ws.Parent.Sheets(2).ChartObjects(2).Chart.HasTitle
    Case 127
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): ws.Copy After:=ws: r = c2.HasTitle & " " & ws.Parent.Sheets(2).ChartObjects(2).Chart.HasTitle
    Case 128
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): ws.Protect: On Error Resume Next: c2.Parent.Activate: r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: ws.Unprotect: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle
    Case 129
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): ws.Protect: On Error Resume Next: c2.Location 1: r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: ws.Unprotect: r = r & " " & ws.ChartObjects.Count & " " & c2.HasTitle
    Case 130
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): ws.Protect: On Error Resume Next: c2.Parent.Activate: r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: ws.Unprotect: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle & " " & TypeName(ActiveChart)
    Case 131
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): ws.Protect: On Error Resume Next: c2.Parent.Select: r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: ws.Unprotect: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle & " " & TypeName(ActiveChart)
    Case 132
        Set c2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 300, 240, 144).Chart: c2.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3"): ws.Protect: On Error Resume Next: c2.ChartArea.Select: r = Err.Number: On Error GoTo 0: ws.Unprotect: r = r & " " & c2.HasTitle & " " & TypeName(ActiveChart)
    Case 133

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, ch As Object, r As Variant, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws).Name = "Two"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets("Two")).Name = "Three"
    ws.Activate
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144)
    Set ch = co.Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
    ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which \ 60
    Case 0: Act0 which, ws, co, ch, r
    Case 1: Act1 which, ws, co, ch, r
    Case 2: Act2 which, ws, co, ch, r
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v & "|" & Read1(wb, ws)
    Err.Clear
    wb.Unprotect: ws.Unprotect: wb.Worksheets("Two").Unprotect
    Err.Clear
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "|saveE" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
